name: Virag CGI + 3D — Signature CGI Concepts
principles: 3D is one controlled campaign mechanism inside a finished designed social post, never the whole render-only output.
Each output must use its assigned Design DNA and be structurally different, not a background or palette swap.
Typography is crisp readable 2D post-production: route-specific headline architecture, maximum two named professional families and three weights.
Use one dominant product-and-headline relationship, one to three compact information modules and two to five coordinated graphic devices.
Preserve Pixel-Locked Product Fidelity, exact facts, current-brief lock, bright-first Human Studio realism and purposeful depth.

commands.label: Campaign CGI Hero
commands.desc: Flagship product-first CGI key visual with one memorable idea.
commands.instruction: Build one premium static CGI campaign around the exact current product/subject. Choose a strong commercial metaphor, deliberate scale, depth, category-fit world and polished lighting. Avoid plain pedestal staging. 3D SOCIAL EXECUTION: Use this mechanism as the CGI layer inside one finished 1080×1350 social design. Build one clear idea, one dominant product-and-headline relationship, one to three compact information modules, and two to five coordinated graphic devices from one visual language. Keep purposeful foreground, midground and background depth; never return an undivided render, pedestal scene or product beauty shot. TYPOGRAPHY LOCK: Render copy as crisp flat 2D post-production type with exact spelling, optical spacing and decisive scale. Use the route's named professional fonts, maximum two families and three weights. Never default every output to a condensed all-caps headline at top-left, and never extrude, melt, warp or perspective-distort glyphs. DIVERGENCE LOCK: Start from a blank canvas and follow the output-specific Design DNA. Against any earlier output, change at least five of seven: concept, camera/crop, product position/scale, headline zone/orientation, font personality, module topology, and graphic/depth language. A background, palette, location or prop swap is not a new design. Preserve Pixel-Locked Product Fidelity, current facts and Human Studio realism. Clean means edited and controlled, never sparse, basic or under-designed.

globalRules: Default to one finished 1080×1350 Instagram content design unless Native Tool Output is selected.
Use one clear campaign idea, one dominant product-and-headline relationship, one to three compact information modules and two to five coordinated graphic devices.
Render all added typography as crisp flat 2D typesetting using the output's named font route, maximum two families and three weights; reject fake, warped, extruded or unreadable glyphs.

Every output starts from a blank canvas. Change at least five of seven fingerprint dimensions versus earlier outputs: concept, camera/crop, product position/scale, headline zone/orientation, type personality, module topology, and graphic/depth language.

A background, palette, location, ingredient or prop swap is not a new design. Reject repeated grid skeletons, especially top-left condensed headline + left icon stack + centered/right product + ingredient pile.
Preserve the uploaded product as an unchanged source layer: no redraw, relight, recolor, deformation, perspective warp, label change or invented geometry.
Use physically credible materials, gravity, contact, scale, shadows and reflections with restrained post-production and subtle real-world imperfection.
Clean means edited and coherent, never sparse or basic; preserve expressive type scale, coordinated graphic architecture, useful information design, tactile detail and foreground/background depth.
Reject cinematic beauty shots, generic glossy CGI, random particles, default neon, decorative rooms, centered pedestals, fake claims, multi-output boards and previous-image reuse.
